messages:
sara_fin: Filing here: Kestrel Labs INV-2029-078 ($42,300.00) returned ACH R03 on 2024-03-18. AP says invoice missing PO number on their side. We sent a soft reminder yesterday but no reply. Need plan: more ACH retries, manual invoice correction, short-term payment plan, or escalate to collections.

billing-bot: Soft reminder email delivered to billing@kestrel.com at 2249994325. ACH auto-retry scheduled (+48h).

eli_sales: Update from AE: procurement requires a PO before releasing wire. They offered to do a partial wire if we accept a split and sign an addendum. Procurement contact is procurement@kestrel.com. Sales willing to coordinate.

tom_ops: I can do two queued ACH retries 48h apart and create a one-time card/pay link. Example command we use in ops:
```
# ops: generate one-time pay link for invoice
redwood billing link create --invoice INV-2029-078 --amt 42300 --ttl 7d
```

sara_fin: Go ahead and queue the retries and generate a 7-day pay link. Also create a ledger export and attach to the formal notice. If 7 days pass with no payment, propose 10% late fee and escalate to internal collections. Holding off on external collections pending legal.

maria_legal: Per SOW §4.2 we need to provide a 30-day cure notice before third-party collection. We can send a formal cure notice now (cc legal) and do internal escalation after 14 days. Any partial-payment addendum must explicitly state that undisputed amounts are due and product access remains at our discretion. If they assert usage disputes, get them documented.

michelle_csr: Drafted formal notice, attaching invoice PDF and ledger snapshot. Sending now to billing@kestrel.com and procurement@kestrel.com, cc legal. Subject: "Formal Notice: Past Due Invoice INV-2029-078 (PO Mismatch)". Included payment options (ACH, wire, card link), and one-time pay link.

billing-bot: One-time payment link generated: https://pay.redwood.example/lnk/klm654 (expires in 7 days).

sara_fin: Logged internal ticket FIN-ESCALATE-INV-2029-078. Plan summary: 1) two ACH retries queued, 2) one-time pay link sent, 3) formal cure notice sent cc:legal, 4) allow 14 days for internal escalation, 5) after internal window, if unpaid follow SOW for external collections. Sales: please push procurement contact; legal: advise if we should permit 50/50 with addendum.

eli_sales: I'll call their CFO and procurement tomorrow AM to nudge and offer to draft the addendum. If they can sign and pay first installment within 72h we'll keep access active.

maria_legal: If we draft an addendum, include: payment schedule, late fee clause, reinstatement terms, and an explicit waiver that undisputed charges remain due. Send to legal for quick review before signing.

michelle_csr: Confirmed formal notice sent at 2249995200 to billing@kestrel.com, procurement@kestrel.com, legal@redwood.example. Copy of notice pasted below for records:
---
Dear Kestrel AP,

Per SOW §4.2, payment on invoice INV-2029-078 is past due. Please remit payment or contact us within 14 days to avoid escalation. Attached: invoice PDF, ledger, pay link, and wire instructions.

Regards,
Redwood Billing
---

sara_fin: Thanks. I'll monitor receipts and mark for external collections after SOW window if unresolved. Update thread when you have any reply. :thumbsup:
